```{r libraries}
library(janitor)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(cowplot)
library(scales)
source(here("R", "00_figure_setup.R"))
```

```{r data-preparation}
# Load data parameters
concept_params_df <- read_csv(here::here("data", "concept_df.csv")) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  group_by(species) %>% 
  mutate(minlfm = min(lfm, na.rm = TRUE),
         maxlfm = max(lfm, na.rm = TRUE),
         minwp = min(mwp, na.rm = TRUE), 
         maxwp = max(mwp, na.rm = TRUE),
         intercept_lfm = 1/intercept) %>% 
  merge(read_csv(here("data", "sp_info.csv"))) %>% 
  clean_names()

traits_df <- read_csv(here("data", "traits_rd_20250327.csv"))

q3_df_raw <- merge(traits_df, concept_params_df, all = TRUE) %>% 
  filter(group == "species") %>% 
  mutate(min_lfm = minlfm,
         min_mwp = minwp,
         p50 = plc50_stem) %>% 
  select(-date, -mwp, -lfm, -ilfm, -x1, -sp_site, -tissue_age) %>% 
  distinct()

# Collapse data to species-level means
q3_df <- q3_df_raw %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarize(
    p50     = mean(p50, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_mwp = mean(min_mwp, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_lfm = mean(min_lfm, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Split datasets to handle with/without Salvia groups at the species level
q3_df_outs <- q3_df %>% filter(!(species %in% c("SALLEU", "SALMEL")))
```

```{r helper-functions}
# Dynamic linetype helper based on significance
get_lm_p <- function(df, y, x) {
  d <- df %>% select(all_of(c(y, x))) %>% filter(is.finite(.data[[y]]), is.finite(.data[[x]]))
  if (nrow(d) < 3) return(NA_real_)
  summary(lm(reformulate(x, y), data = d))$coefficients[2, 4]
}

# STANDARD LOGIC: Non-significant lines (p >= 0.05) are dashed
lt_from_p <- function(p, alpha = 0.05) {
  ifelse(is.na(p), "dashed", ifelse(p < alpha, "solid", "dashed"))
}
```

```{r plotting-panels}
# Extract linetypes dynamically based on p-values
lt_A_salv   <- lt_from_p(get_lm_p(q3_df,      "min_mwp", "p50"))
lt_A_nosalv <- lt_from_p(get_lm_p(q3_df_outs, "min_mwp", "p50"))

lt_B_salv   <- lt_from_p(get_lm_p(q3_df,      "min_lfm", "p50"))
lt_B_nosalv <- lt_from_p(get_lm_p(q3_df_outs, "min_lfm", "p50"))

# Increased text size layout configurations
axis_theme <- theme_bw(base_size = 14) + 
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.text  = element_text(size = 13),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 6, r = 6, b = 6, l = 6)
  )

# --- Panel A ---
fig5a <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = q3_df, aes(x = p50, y = min_mwp, color = species), size = 2.5) +
  geom_point(data = filter(q3_df, species %in% c("SALLEU", "SALMEL")), 
             aes(x = p50, y = min_mwp, color = species), shape = 1, size = 6) +
  color_species +
  geom_smooth(data = q3_df, aes(x = p50, y = min_mwp), 
              method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "grey50", linetype = lt_A_salv) +
  geom_smooth(data = q3_df_outs, aes(x = p50, y = min_mwp), 
              method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black", linetype = lt_A_nosalv) +
  labs(x = "P50 (MPa)", y = expression(Psi[MDmin]~"(MPa)")) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-1.0, -10.0)) + 
  axis_theme

# --- Panel B ---
fig5b <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = q3_df, aes(x = p50, y = min_lfm, color = species), size = 2.5) +
  geom_point(data = filter(q3_df, species %in% c("SALLEU", "SALMEL")), 
             aes(x = p50, y = min_lfm, color = species), shape = 1, size = 6) +
  color_species +
  geom_smooth(data = q3_df, aes(x = p50, y = min_lfm), 
              method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "grey50", linetype = lt_B_salv) +
  geom_smooth(data = q3_df_outs, aes(x = p50, y = min_lfm), 
              method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black", linetype = lt_B_nosalv) +
  labs(x = "P50 (MPa)", y = "LFMmin (%)") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1.0), labels = c(40, 60, 80, 100)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-1.0, -10.0)) + 
  axis_theme
```

```{r build-legends}
# Create standalone legends to replicate the original layout structure
legend_data_df <- tibble(
  x = c(1, 2, 3, 4), y = c(1, 2, 3, 4),
  Dataset = c("With Salvia", "Without Salvia", "With Salvia", "Without Salvia"),
  Significance = c("p < 0.05", "p >= 0.05", "p < 0.05", "p >= 0.05")
)

leg_dataset <- get_legend(
  ggplot(legend_data_df, aes(x, y, linetype = Dataset)) +
    geom_line(aes(color = Dataset), linewidth = 1.0) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c("With Salvia" = "dashed", "Without Salvia" = "solid")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("With Salvia" = "grey50", "Without Salvia" = "black")) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) + 
    theme(legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"), legend.text = element_text(size = 11))
)

# Legend updated to show p >= 0.05 as dashed line
leg_sig <- get_legend(
  ggplot(legend_data_df, aes(x, y, linetype = Significance)) +
    geom_line(color = "#2b5cff", linewidth = 1.0) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c("p < 0.05" = "solid", "p >= 0.05" = "dashed")) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) + 
    theme(legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"), legend.text = element_text(size = 11))
)

leg_species <- get_legend(
  fig5a + guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 1, title = "Species")) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"), legend.text = element_text(size = 10.5))
)

# Bundle right-side legends cleanly
right_legends <- plot_grid(
  leg_dataset,
  leg_species,
  leg_sig,
  ncol = 1, align = "v", rel_heights = c(0.18, 0.72, 0.1)
)
```

```{r combine-and-save}
# Combine the vertical layout panel stack
plots_stacked <- plot_grid(
  fig5a + theme(legend.position = "none", axis.title.x = element_blank()),
  fig5b + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  ncol = 1,
  labels = c("A", "B"),
  label_fontface = "bold", label_size = 16,
  label_x = 0.03, label_y = 0.97,
  hjust = 0, vjust = 1
)

# Bind structural panels and legends
final_figure <- plot_grid(plots_stacked, right_legends, nrow = 1, rel_widths = c(1, 0.38))
final_figure

# Smaller overall figure constraints to force the typography pop
ggsave(
  plot = final_figure,
  filename = here::here("output", "figures", "main", "Fig_08_P50_vs_params.jpg"),
  dpi = 600,
  width = 6.5,
  height = 7.5
)
```

```{r species-level-stats}
# ==========================================================================
# Run and extract stats on a species level
# ==========================================================================

# 1. Define species models
models <- list(
  "Panel A: With Salvia"    = lm(min_mwp ~ p50, data = q3_df),
  "Panel A: Without Salvia" = lm(min_mwp ~ p50, data = q3_df_outs),
  "Panel B: With Salvia"    = lm(min_lfm ~ p50, data = q3_df),
  "Panel B: Without Salvia" = lm(min_lfm ~ p50, data = q3_df_outs)
)

# 2. Extract statistics cleanly into a summary table
stats_summary <- map_df(names(models), function(name) {
  fit <- models[[name]]
  coefs <- summary(fit)$coefficients
  
  tibble(
    Analysis       = name,
    Intercept      = round(coefs[1, 1], 3),
    Slope          = round(coefs[2, 1], 3),
    R_squared      = round(summary(fit)$r.squared, 3),
    p_value        = signif(coefs[2, 4], 3),
    N              = nobs(fit),
    df_residual    = fit$df.residual
  )
})

# Print table to console
print(stats_summary)
```
